items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I think that's who he used to play with before George Lurice got with René's band. He was playing with Kid René.

ctx.x: Zeb he was a good clarinet player too around here. I'm trying to think was he playing with René before George Lurice. I think that's who he used to play with before George Lurice got with René's band. He was playing with Kid René. Well he was good too. Him and George the boy they well now they got a few but I couldn't swear I used to hear them like Lorenzo Teo. He heard of him. Yes. And another one I can't call his name but he was supposed to be great too but I can't swear I heard him. No. No but Zeb and George…
About when was that that George Boyd died do you remember?
